## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)

## Testing

- [ ] `composer test` passes (static analysis, formatting check, type coverage, unit tests)
- [ ] Live imgproxy tests are skipped or accounted for (gated behind `IMGPROXY_URL` / `IMGPROXY_KEY` / `IMGPROXY_SALT`)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [code of conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] I have added tests covering the new behavior, or explained why none are needed
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / API reference if the public surface changed
- [ ] I have updated the CHANGELOG and UPGRADING if the change is user-facing
- [ ] My changes keep type coverage and static analysis green
